scenario: The ego car travels straight through an intersection while an oncoming car executes a U-turn.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection.

adversarials.behavior: The car approaches from the opposite direction and executes a U-turn at the intersection.

spatial_relation: The ego car and the adversarial car are on opposite approaches to the same intersection, facing each other initially.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego car must maintain a set distance from the intersection at spawn, and the scenario terminates once the ego car has cleared the intersection.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the forward-moving car from first-person view; the oncoming U-turn vehicle is the adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initially both approach the intersection from opposite directions; midpoint the adversarial begins its U-turn while ego continues straight; ending the ego exits the intersection as the adversarial completes its turn. 4. Evidence: the adversarial's heading reverses across frames while the ego maintains constant forward trajectory.
